applies_to: YORK YMAE air-to-water modular heat pumps with inverter compressors in the four-pipe (simultaneous heating and cooling) version.
summary: The YMAE is the YORK by Johnson Controls modular air-to-water heat pump with inverter compressors; the four-pipe version heats and cools at the same time. Its BAS points list gives BACnet objects next to N2 and Modbus addresses: on/off and mode commands, entering and leaving water setpoints for cooling and heating, chiller-level status and temperatures, and module-level circuit values and bit-coded fault words. Module data is read one module at a time through AV 8.
notes: Access comes from the Modbus function code column: points written with function 06 are marked writable, function 03 points read-only.
The sheet does not name the BACnet interface or transport; its notes describe the unit's Modbus RTU link (9600 baud, 8-N-1) with the BAS as leader.
Writable setpoint ranges (IP units) are in the descriptions; SI ranges are in the sheet.

All MV enums are printed in the points table and the sheet has no add-1 note. Multistate states with their own enum in the points table are shown as printed, from 0. BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the device may report the printed number + 1; confirm by discovery (read the state text).
The Fault point in the sheet has no BACnet object and is left out.

integration.summary: Enable BAS start/stop and mode at the HMI (MV 4 and MV 3 show the selection), then switch the unit with MV 1 and pick the mode with MV 2. Write the leaving (or entering) water setpoints for cooling and heating, and read BV 100 for actual on/off, chiller loading, the chiller leaving water temperatures and the unit fault words.

minimum_points.name: CHILLER ON|OFF (CMD)
minimum_points.why: On/off command (1 = on, 2 = off, as printed)

minimum_points.name: RUNNING MODE
minimum_points.why: Mode: cooling, heating, pump only, both

minimum_points.name: CHILLER ON|OFF CONTROL SELECTION
minimum_points.why: On/off source; must include BAS (set at HMI)

integration.enable: BAS start/stop and operating-mode control are enabled at the HMI. MV 4 (on/off source: HMI, Remote, HMI+BAS) and MV 3 (mode source: HMI, Remote, HMI+BAS, BAS) show the selection and are read-only over the network.
setup: The sheet's notes describe the microboard's Modbus RTU link: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit; the BAS is the leader and module 1's microboard the follower. BAS addresses are set at the HMI.
BV 5 and BV 6 show whether cooling and heating control on entering or leaving water temperature; write the matching setpoints (AV 1/AV 2 or AV 3/AV 4).
gotchas: MV 1 only commands on/off; read the real state from BV 100.
A BAS setpoint can be outside the unit's default range; read the setpoints back from the unit after writing.
Data defaults to the leader module (No. 1). Write AV 8 to view another module's values; per-module AVs then show that module.

points.name: FAULT STATUS 1
points.states: Bit 0=Unit cooling entering water temperature sensor fault, Bit 1=Ambient temperature sensor fault, Bit 2=Circuit 1 coil temperature sensor fault, Bit 3=Circuit 2 coil temperature sensor fault, Bit 4=Unit cooling leaving water temperature sensor fault, Bit 5=Chiller cooling leaving water temperature sensor fault, Bit 6=Circuit 1 accumulator inlet temperature sensor fault, Bit 7=Circuit 2 accumulator inlet temperature sensor fault, Bit 8=Circuit 1 compressor 1 discharge port temperature sensor fault, Bit 10=Circuit 2 compressor 1 discharge port temperature sensor fault, Bit 12=Circuit 1 economizer entering temperature sensor fault, Bit 13=Circuit 1 economizer leaving temperature sensor fault, Bit 14=Circuit 2 economizer entering temperature sensor fault, Bit 15=Circuit 2 economizer leaving temperature sensor fault (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 2
points.states: Bit 0=Unit heating leaving water temperature sensor fault, Bit 1=Chiller heating leaving water temperature sensor fault, Bit 2=Unit heating entering water temperature sensor fault, Bit 3=Circuit 1 low pressure transducer fault, Bit 4=Circuit 2 low pressure transducer fault, Bit 5=Circuit 1 high pressure transducer fault, Bit 6=Circuit 2 high pressure transducer fault (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 3
points.states: Bit 0=Circuit 1 fan motor fault, Bit 1=Circuit 2 fan motor fault, Bit 2=Circuit 1 high pressure switch fault, Bit 3=Circuit 1 low pressure switch fault, Bit 4=Chiller cooling Water flow fault, Bit 7=External interlock fault, Bit 8=Power fault, Bit 9=Circuit 2 high pressure switch fault, Bit 10=Circuit 2 low pressure switch fault, Bit 11=Unit cooling Water flow fault, Bit 12=Unit heating Water flow fault, Bit 13=Chiller heating Water flow fault (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 5
points.states: Bit 0=Communication failure (Follower unit with leader), Bit 1=Chiller Dial Switch setting error, Bit 2=Time limit protection, Bit 3=Low ambient temperature in cooling, Bit 4=High ambient temperature in heating, Bit 5=Chiller low leaving temperature in cooling, Bit 6=Chiller high leaving temperature in heating, Bit 7=Chiller locking, Bit 8=Communication failure (FCU with leader), Bit 10=Unit low leaving temperature in cooling, Bit 12=Unit high leaving temperature in heating, Bit 14=Unit low leaving temperature in heatinging (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 6
points.states: Bit 0=Circuit 1 compressor 1 high discharge port temperature, Bit 2=Circuit 2 compressor 1 high discharge port temperature, Bit 8=Circuit 1 cooling brazed plate heat exchanger anti-freeze protect, Bit 9=Circuit 2 Cooling brazed plate heat exchanger anti-freeze protect, Bit 10=Circuit 1 heating brazed plate heat exchanger anti-freeze protect, Bit 11=Circuit 2 heating brazed plate heat exchanger anti-freeze protect, Bit 14=Circuit 1 four way valve action failure, Bit 15=Circuit 2 four way valve action failure (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 7
points.states: Bit 0=Unit Dial Switch setting error, Bit 1=Communication failure (unit with circuit 1 driver), Bit 2=Communication failure (unit with circuit 1 fan), Bit 3=Communication failure (unit with circuit 2 fan), Bit 4=Communication failure (unit with circuit 2 driver), Bit 5=Driver fault or inverter compressor fault, Bit 7=Circuit 1 fan motor overspeed, Bit 8=Circuit 2 fan motor overspeed, Bit 9=Circuit 1 fan motor underspeed, Bit 10=Circuit 2 fan motor underspeed, Bit 11=Circuit 1 VSD heat dissipation alarm, Bit 12=Circuit 2 VSD heat dissipation alarm, Bit 13=Communication failure (Mainboard with Expansion Board) (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 8
points.states: Bit 2=Circuit 1 High pressure alarm, Bit 3=Circuit 2 High pressure alarm, Bit 4=Circuit 1 Low discharge pressure alarm, Bit 5=Circuit 2 Low discharge pressure alarm, Bit 6=Circuit 1 Low pressure alarm, Bit 7=Circuit 2 Low pressure alarm (1=fault)
